query:
-- Check for collision slugs
SELECT id, slug, title, status, updated_at, LENGTH(content) as content_length
FROM blog_posts
WHERE slug IN (
  'what-are-dental-implants-cost',
  'clear-aligners-vs-braces',
  'wwhat-are-dental-implants-cost',
  'cclear-aligners-vs-braces'
)
ORDER BY slug;
